biography.bio:
Mechanic by day, master of disguise on the job - he can pass for almost anyone, and has.

Masks: Penetrator, Ditcher (wearing Penetrator).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.i7jFeb5bzN0U3VKv]{Firecracker}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.dR6jjkV0BdJPEycJ]{Firecracker Dirt Bike}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.bQJHSrREvvCnE05C]{Hurricane}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.4ba8qbQd3kCK4Lkc]{Wildcat}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
By day you have an ordinary life, and you work hard to keep it. Your Cover starts at 5. While it holds and you wear no mask, your Deception Tests have Edge. When the GM decides you slipped - seen unmasking, a vehicle followed home - you lose 1 Cover; at 0 your identity is blown. Once per mission, lying low restores 1.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

steps.message: Cover blown - V.E.N.O.M. knows who this agent really is.

steps.text: {name} lies low and shores up their cover.

automation.notes:
Pool: Cover, 5. Automatic: Deception Tests have Edge while Cover is above 0 and you wear no mask. Use buttons: lose 1 Cover (a chat warning when it reaches 0), and once per mission restore 1.

Left to the table: when the cover slips.

system.description:
Gouges deep trenches in earth and rock - the ground just drops away under the enemy.

Buddie Hawks's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the Evasion of each enemy within 15 ft; a hit knocks it Prone. The trench itself (difficult terrain) is up to the GM. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Lets its wearer turn intangible for a moment - long enough to slip through a wall, a locked door or someone's grip.

Buddie Hawks's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

steps.text: {name} phases out - able to pass through solid objects until the end of the turn.

automation.notes: Phase marks the wearer until the end of the turn: immune to Grappled, Restrained and Immobilized while it lasts. Moving through walls and objects is up to the GM - walls on the scene still block the token. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A wig, a uniform and a new walk, and nobody looks twice. Without a mask on, your Deception and Infiltration Tests have Edge - a M.A.S.K. helmet is not much of a disguise.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.
